title: Cloud Computing Fundamentals
blurb: Core cloud concepts, service models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS), shared responsibility, deployment types, and economic models.

title: Azure Architecture and Resource Management
blurb: Global infrastructure, regions, availability zones, management hierarchy, Azure Resource Manager (ARM), and resource tagging.

title: Virtual Machines and Compute
blurb: Azure compute decision matrix, Linux and Windows VMs, sizing, managed disks, SSH/Bastion connectivity, and VM scale sets.

title: App Service and Serverless Functions
blurb: Hosting web apps and APIs on App Service, deployment slots, custom domains, and event-driven Azure Functions.

title: Storage Accounts and Blob Storage
blurb: Storage account types, redundancy options (LRS/ZRS/GRS), Blob tiers, SAS tokens, and lifecycle management rules.

title: Azure SQL and Cosmos DB
blurb: Azure SQL Database, DTU vs vCore models, and Azure Cosmos DB multi-model APIs, Request Units, and consistency levels.

title: Virtual Networks and Connectivity
blurb: VNets, subnets, Network Security Groups, load balancing options, VNet peering, and private endpoints.

title: Microsoft Entra ID and Key Vault
blurb: Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, Multi-Factor Authentication, Azure Key Vault secrets, and managed identities.

title: Monitoring and Observability
blurb: Azure Monitor metrics, Log Analytics workspaces, Kusto Query Language (KQL), Application Insights, and alerts.

title: Containers, Container Apps, and AKS
blurb: Azure Container Registry (ACR), Azure Container Instances (ACI), Azure Container Apps, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).

title: Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD
blurb: Declarative ARM templates, Bicep DSL, what-if deployments, GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows, and OIDC federation.

title: Governance, Well-Architected, and Security
blurb: Cost management, budgets, Azure Policy, resource locks, Defender for Cloud, SLAs, and the 5 Well-Architected pillars.
